en.title: White Lotus Breakout Adam DiMarco Dives Into Dark Ocean's First Feature
en.summary: Adam DiMarco, the breakout star of HBO's 'The White Lotus,' is set to lead Glassriver's inaugural feature film, 'Dark Ocean.' The project promises a deep dive into a starkly masculine world.
en.body:
The buzz surrounding **Adam DiMarco**, the charismatic actor who captured audiences' attention as Albie in the acclaimed HBO series **The White Lotus**, continues to grow. He has officially been attached to star in **Glassriver’s** first feature film, an Icelandic production titled **‘Dark Ocean’**. This move marks a significant step for both DiMarco and the burgeoning production company.

Directed by **Baldvin Z**, known for his work on Icelandic series like *Trapped*, **‘Dark Ocean’** is described as delving into the “hyper-masculine world” of a trawler. This setting suggests a stark contrast to the luxurious, interpersonal dramas that have defined DiMarco’s recent success. The film also boasts a notable Icelandic creative team, with **Baltasar Kormákur** and **Ólafur Darri Ólafsson** also involved, hinting at a production deeply rooted in its national cinematic identity.

## Diving Into New Depths

DiMarco's ascent in Hollywood has been rapid since his memorable role in **The White Lotus**. His ability to convey complex emotions with a nuanced performance quickly made him a fan favorite. Prior to his breakout role, he honed his craft in various television series, including the Syfy show **The Magicians** and the Netflix series **The Order**, showcasing a versatility that now appears poised for a dramatic exploration in **‘Dark Ocean’**. The film's premise, focusing on the isolated and demanding environment of a fishing trawler, offers a compelling platform for DiMarco to explore a different facet of his acting prowess. Details regarding the full cast and specific plot points beyond the atmospheric setting are still emerging, but the involvement of established Icelandic talent alongside a rising international star like DiMarco generates considerable anticipation.

## Fan Anticipation Builds

Fans of **Adam DiMarco** have eagerly followed his career trajectory since his impactful performance in **The White Lotus**. The announcement of his leading role in **‘Dark Ocean’** has sparked considerable discussion across fan forums and social media. Many are excited to see him tackle a potentially grittier, more intense role, diverging from the character of Albie. The prospect of him navigating the challenges of a maritime setting, likely filled with the inherent drama and psychological tension associated with such an environment, is a key point of conversation. The film’s Icelandic origins also add an element of intrigue, promising a unique cultural perspective and aesthetic that fans hope will complement DiMarco's performance.

## What's Next

While **‘Dark Ocean’** represents a significant upcoming project for **Adam DiMarco**, further details regarding its production timeline and release strategy have not yet been announced. Fans can look forward to updates as the film gears up for production.

content_raw: The Canadian joins Baltasar Kormákur and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson on the first film from the Icelandic production company, set in the "hyper-masculine world" of a trawler and to be directed by Baldvin Z.
